summary: rollup-packages-polyfill-core executes base64-obfuscated npm install of external package at require time
details: On require of the package's main entry (dist/index.js), top-level code decodes a base64 string to the shell command `npm install geomark --no-save --silent --no-audit --no-fund` and spawns it via child_process with stdio ignored and windowsHide set. After the install completes, the code decodes a second base64 literal to the module name `geomark`, requires it, and immediately invokes `svgo.getPlugin()()`. Both the install command and the required module name are stored as base64 to hide them from readers and static scanners. Fetching and executing an arbitrary external, mutable npm package at import time is unrelated to the package's advertised rollup polyfill purpose. The package name also resembles rollup-plugin-polyfill-node.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
